item: Sink sweep 5/n: thread names are scrubbed where they are recorded
summary: A thread is named from a request (oo-osm-code, served-cache-key, oo-dump-key), so its name can hold a passphrase. thread_snapshot scrubs the name at both snapshot sites, the session-forensics member nets older snapshots, the damage record scrubs the calling thread's name before it is written, and the write-gate and memory-stop log lines scrub the holder; a planted-marker test and a source guard fail when any of them goes.
